dialogues.jp: マンガでも買おうと、本屋に向かう。
dialogues.en: I headed to the bookstore to buy some manga.
dialogues.text: I headed to the bookstore to buy some manga.

dialogues.jp:
３月に入り、段々と気温は穏やかになってきた。
そろそろ春を実感出来る季節だ。
dialogues.en:
Being March, the temperature had slowly gotten warmer. It's
starting to feel a lot more like spring now.
dialogues.text:
Being March, the temperature had slowly gotten warmer. It's
starting to feel a lot more like spring now.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、年中咲いている桜のせいで、その実
感もバーゲンセールって感じなのだが。
dialogues.en:
Although, thanks to those year-round blooming Sakura, the
only way to really tell when it's spring now is by the
bargain sales.
dialogues.text:
Although, thanks to those year-round blooming Sakura, the
only way to really tell when it's spring now is by the
bargain sales.

dialogues.jp: 「おっと」
dialogues.en: "Oops."
dialogues.text: "Oops."

dialogues.jp:
本屋に入ろうとして、同時に入ろうとした人と
ぶつかりそうになってしまった。
dialogues.en:
As I entered the bookstore, I bumped into someone else
leaving at the same time.
dialogues.text:
As I entered the bookstore, I bumped into someone else
leaving at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「すみません……って、何だ、朝倉君か。こん
　ちわっす」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry... oh, Asakura-kun. Good afternoon!"
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry... oh, Asakura-kun. Good afternoon!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こんちは。ことりも、本屋に買い物？」
dialogues.en: "Afternoon. Were you shopping at the bookstore as well?"
dialogues.text: "Afternoon. Were you shopping at the bookstore as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん。予約しておいた本が、今日届いたって
　電話があったから。朝倉君は？」
dialogues.en:
"Uh huh. The book that I reserved some time back has just
came in. What about you?"
dialogues.text:
"Uh huh. The book that I reserved some time back has just
came in. What about you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、適当に。マンガでも買おうかと思って」
dialogues.en: "Well, nothing much. Just thinking of buying some manga."
dialogues.text: "Well, nothing much. Just thinking of buying some manga."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君って、どんなの読むの？」
dialogues.en: "Hm, what kind of manga do you read?"
dialogues.text: "Hm, what kind of manga do you read?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、それは売ってたら見せるよ」
dialogues.en: "I'd let you see after I buy it."
dialogues.text: "I'd let you see after I buy it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「売ってるといいな♪」
dialogues.en: "I'd be waiting♪"
dialogues.text: "I'd be waiting♪"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「売ってました？」
dialogues.en: "Have you finished already?"
dialogues.text: "Have you finished already?"

dialogues.jp:
レジで商品を受け取るだけだったことりは、俺
よりも先に店を出ていた。
dialogues.en:
I finished paying for the manga at the register, then headed
out of the store to where Kotori was waiting.
dialogues.text:
I finished paying for the manga at the register, then headed
out of the store to where Kotori was waiting.

dialogues.jp: 「はい、これ」
dialogues.en: "Yup, here it is."
dialogues.text: "Yup, here it is."

dialogues.jp: 茶色の紙封筒を手渡す。
dialogues.en: I passed the brown envelope-like bag to her.
dialogues.text: I passed the brown envelope-like bag to her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「開けていいんですか」
dialogues.en: "May I open it?"
dialogues.text: "May I open it?"

dialogues.jp: うなずくと、がさがさ中身を取りだした。
dialogues.en: I nodded in assent, and she opened the envelope skillfully.
dialogues.text: I nodded in assent, and she opened the envelope skillfully.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「これって…………料理マンガ？」
dialogues.en: "This is........ a cooking manga?"
dialogues.text: "This is........ a cooking manga?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
とんでもない食材を使って読者の度肝を抜くマ
ンガで、料理を食べた後のリアクションが激し
くて面白い。
dialogues.en:
It has some nice cooking tips, but that's not the main
reason I bought it. I just love the reactions of the people
who eat the food."
dialogues.text:
It has some nice cooking tips, but that's not the main
reason I bought it. I just love the reactions of the people
who eat the food."

dialogues.jp:
本当はウケを狙ってもっと違ったものを買おう
かとも思ったんだが。
dialogues.en: A double reason to buy it, essentially.
dialogues.text: A double reason to buy it, essentially.

dialogues.jp:
「うちには食える材料を使って食えない料理を
　作れるシェフがいるんでね。これで少し勉強
　してもらおうと思ってな」
dialogues.en:
"There's a chef at home who can't cook anything no matter
the ingredients provided, so I figured I'd better study on
this subject."
dialogues.text:
"There's a chef at home who can't cook anything no matter
the ingredients provided, so I figured I'd better study on
this subject."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「マンガで……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Using... a manga?"
dialogues.text: "Using... a manga?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、普通の方法じゃどうあっても食えない
　もんしかできないから。これぐらいトンデモ
　ナイ方がいいんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's not normal, but I might as well mix work and
pleasure. Besides, what I learn from this can't be any worse
than what she makes..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's not normal, but I might as well mix work and
pleasure. Besides, what I learn from this can't be any worse
than what she makes..."

dialogues.jp: ……たぶん。
dialogues.en: ...More or less.
dialogues.text: ...More or less.

dialogues.jp: 「で、ことりは何を買ったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, what did you buy?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, what did you buy?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Me?"
dialogues.text: "Me?"

dialogues.jp:
あらかじめ用意していたのか、すっと本を差し
出してきた。
dialogues.en: She passed the already-opened book to me.
dialogues.text: She passed the already-opened book to me.

dialogues.jp:
「ん……？　“正しい声楽”。……ああ、歌の
　本ね」
dialogues.en: "Hmm? "Perfect Vocal Music". ......Ahh, a music book."
dialogues.text: "Hmm? "Perfect Vocal Music". ......Ahh, a music book."

dialogues.jp: 固い表紙で、いかにも高そうな本だった。
dialogues.en: It was a large, hard-cover book.
dialogues.text: It was a large, hard-cover book.

dialogues.jp:
「なるほどな。確かにこういうのは、取り寄せ
　じゃないと買えないかも」
dialogues.en:
"I see. I can understand why you needed to order this, it
probably isn't sold on shelves normally."
dialogues.text:
"I see. I can understand why you needed to order this, it
probably isn't sold on shelves normally."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それに、時間も掛かるんですから。マメな自
　分に、拍手したいぐらいですよ、ほんと」
dialogues.en:
"And I came here right on the day it came in! I should
deserve some applause for my dedication, really."
dialogues.text:
"And I came here right on the day it came in! I should
deserve some applause for my dedication, really."

dialogues.jp: パチパチ。
dialogues.en: --*clap clap*
dialogues.text: --*clap clap*

dialogues.jp: 俺が拍手すると。
dialogues.en: I clapped my hands together.
dialogues.text: I clapped my hands together.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうもです」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you, thank you."

dialogues.jp: 少しだけ照れたことりがぺこりと頭を下げた。
dialogues.en: The slightly embarassed Kotori bowed multiple times.
dialogues.text: The slightly embarassed Kotori bowed multiple times.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、やっぱことりって歌が好きなんだな」
dialogues.en: "You must really like singing."
dialogues.text: "You must really like singing."

dialogues.jp: 本を受け取りながら、ことりは首を傾げた。
dialogues.en:
I return the book to her, as she tilted her head slightly in
thought.
dialogues.text:
I return the book to her, as she tilted her head slightly in
thought.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、どうでしょうね。好きなのかな……」
dialogues.en:
"Weeell, I wouldn't exactly say that... how would I put
it..."
dialogues.text:
"Weeell, I wouldn't exactly say that... how would I put
it..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「好きだから上手だし、こういう本を買って、
　勉強するんだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"You like it and want to get better, so you bought this book
to improve yourself, right?"
dialogues.text:
"You like it and want to get better, so you bought this book
to improve yourself, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、そうかもしれないですね」
dialogues.en: "Well, I don't know about that."
dialogues.text: "Well, I don't know about that."

dialogues.jp: 何か、引っかかる言い方だった。
dialogues.en: What's she being so evasive about?
dialogues.text: What's she being so evasive about?

dialogues.jp: 「違うの？」
dialogues.en: "Is that wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Is that wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何だか、分からないんですよね、自分でも」
dialogues.en: "Well, heh, I don't really know myself..."
dialogues.text: "Well, heh, I don't really know myself..."

dialogues.jp:
どことなく｛じちょう／自嘲｝めいた笑みを浮かべ、ことりは
言った。
dialogues.en:
With a curiously wistful smile, Kotori's unclear words hung
in the air for a moment.
dialogues.text:
With a curiously wistful smile, Kotori's unclear words hung
in the air for a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「分かるようになれれば、いいと思うんですけ
　どね……」
dialogues.en: "If I really knew, that would be so nice..."
dialogues.text: "If I really knew, that would be so nice..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃ、私は机にかじりついて鬼のように
　読まなければいけないので、これにて帰りま
　す」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I'm going home to tear into this book."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'm going home to tear into this book."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ばいばいきーん」
dialogues.en: "Bye bye kiin!"
dialogues.text: "Bye bye kiin!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「バイバイ……菌？」
dialogues.en: "Bye bye... kiin?"
dialogues.text: "Bye bye... kiin?"

dialogues.jp:
微妙な挨拶を春先の空気に残して、ことりは去っ
ていったのだった。
dialogues.en:
As her subtle farewell hung in the air, Kotori left the
shoping district.
dialogues.text:
As her subtle farewell hung in the air, Kotori left the
shoping district.

dialogues.jp: 「空元気……なのかな？」
dialogues.en: "...Trying to act cool?"
dialogues.text: "...Trying to act cool?"

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりと歌◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori and Singing◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori and Singing◆

dialogues.jp:
本屋へと行くと、偶然にもことりに出会った。
ことりは、歌の本を買いに来たらしい。
dialogues.en:
As I walked into the bookshop, I met Kotori by chance.
Kotori had went to the bookshop to buy a music book.
dialogues.text:
As I walked into the bookshop, I met Kotori by chance.
Kotori had went to the bookshop to buy a music book.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは歌が好きなんだな、そう言うと、こと
りは妙にあやふやな態度を見せたのだった。
dialogues.en:
When I said that Kotori must really like singing, her
response and attitude was far more vague than I was
expecting.
dialogues.text:
When I said that Kotori must really like singing, her
response and attitude was far more vague than I was
expecting.
